Question
========
Tick all the terms that define a good performance requirement.


Answerlist
----------
* Super
* Symmetrical
* Measurable
* Metric
* Acceptable
* Agnostic
* Realizable
* Rate
* Thorough
* Specific
* Magic
* Translatable

Solution
========
A good performance requirement is SMART: Specific, Measurable, Acceptable, Realizable and Thorough.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. Not part of the definition.
* 0. Not part of the definition.
* 1. M in SMART: the requirement must be quantifiable.
* 0. A metric is what you measure, not a property of the requirement.
* 1. A in SMART: the target must be acceptable to the stakeholders.
* 0. Not part of the definition.
* 1. R in SMART: the target must be achievable.
* 0. Not part of the definition.
* 1. T in SMART: the requirement must cover the relevant conditions.
* 1. S in SMART: the requirement must be unambiguous.
* 0. Not part of the definition.
* 0. Not part of the definition.
